passing_score_scale: Pass/fail; passing threshold not publicly disclosed
exam_format: Linear (computer-based, online proctored via Pearson VUE OnVUE or at authorized test centers). ACE adds Scenario-Based questions.

testing_centers.notes: Pearson VUE test centers globally and online proctoring via Pearson VUE OnVUE. Also delivered via Alibaba Cloud Certification test centers in China and online proctoring globally.

id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID required. Passport required for international candidates.
exam_rules: Closed-book; no aids; no personal devices permitted during exam. ACE includes a 4-hour hands-on scenario exam in addition to the MCQ portion. Online proctored globally via Pearson VUE OnVUE.
renewal_options: Certifications are valid for 3 years. Renewal is exam-based only: pass the current version of the same exam or a higher-level exam. No continuing education (CE) credits accepted — exam-based renewal only.

retake_policy.notes: 14-day waiting period between failed attempts. No stated maximum number of attempts. Full exam fee required for each attempt.

editorial.meta_description: The Alibaba Cloud ACA Security Associate exam is retired as of May 13, 2025. Please prepare for its verified successor, CSA-C01, for your certification needs.
editorial.overview: The Alibaba Cloud Security Associate certification historically covered cloud security fundamentals, identity management, data encryption, security products, and incident response across a total of 60 questions with a maximum duration of 120 minutes. Certifying body Alibaba Cloud officially retired this exam on May 13, 2025. Its verified direct successor is CSA-C01, which is the current standard for cloud security professionals.
editorial.who_should_take: Cloud administrators, security engineers, and IT professionals seeking to validate their knowledge of Alibaba Cloud security controls and products. Candidates should focus their efforts on the current CSA-C01 certification path to maintain their professional credentials.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Do not attempt to schedule or study specifically for this retired exam. Direct your preparation toward the verified successor, CSA-C01. Core security principles transfer completely, but you must align your study plan with the current official documentation and exam guides for the active credential to ensure you are ready for the new requirements.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers fundamental principles of cloud security architecture, shared responsibility models, and basic threat landscapes relevant to protecting enterprise cloud environments against unauthorized access and various modern digital exploits.

This domain focuses on identity and access management controls, user privileges, policies, and multi-factor authentication mechanisms within the cloud environment to ensure operational security and proper authorization for all users.

This domain addresses data encryption methods, key management service concepts, and cryptographic protections applied to data at rest and data in transit across all connected cloud storage volumes and network paths.

This domain examines native security products, various tooling options, and defensive configurations available within the ecosystem to mitigate emergent risks and effectively secure the underlying cloud infrastructure for all enterprise users.

This domain outlines standard incident response procedures, proactive threat detection, log analysis, and methodical remediation steps following unexpected security events or potential breaches in the cloud environment for all active users.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Because this exam is retired and no longer available for registration, you cannot schedule an exam day for it. Focus your testing plans on the successor certification, CSA-C01, which is administered online via Pearson VUE OnVUE or at authorized test centers.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The examination consists of a total of exactly 60 questions presented in multiple choice and multiple response formats designed to evaluate candidate proficiency in cloud security.
The evaluation uses a pass/fail grading scale where the specific numerical passing threshold is not publicly disclosed by Alibaba Cloud for this retired certification credential.
Test takers are given a total duration of 120 minutes to complete all questions on the computer-based test before the time officially expires for the candidate.

faq.question_title: What is the successor to this retired exam?
faq.answer_text: The verified successor exam is CSA-C01, which represents the current path and official standard for candidates seeking Alibaba Cloud security certification in the modern cloud era.

methodology.summary: This page was built using official Alibaba Cloud study documentation, exam guides, and lifecycle notices indicating retirement status and successor paths for the Alibaba Cloud security certification program.
